710-3055-8095.notablePrerequisites: Gift of Immortality attached to Danitha.
710-3055-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, Gift of Immortality triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Gift of Immortality from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

628-728-5007.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Morselhoarder.
When Morselhoarder dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability
Activate Morselhoarder by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, adding one mana of any color
Repeat.
628-728-5007.notes: The remaining -1/-1 counter can be removed each loop to gain infinite colored mana.

1417-2438-2738-4871.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Bridge from Below, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bridge from Below trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2626-3652-4986-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Ornithopter.
Activate Salvager of Ruin by sacrificing it, returning Ornithopter from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Salvager of Ruin from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2469-2842-5220-6900.description:
Cast Phyrexian Dreadnought from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought enters, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought dies, Mortuary and Blood Artist trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Phyrexian Dreadnought from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

5147-6258--5.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Thunderous Velocipede
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat

3887-5195-7496.easyPrerequisites: You control at least four creatures.
3887-5195-7496.description:
Cast Lab Rats with buyback by paying {B} due to its affinity for creatures.
Storm-Kiln Aritst triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Lab Rats, creating a creature token and returning Lab Rats to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

372-1018-7431.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Daydream exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-1018-7431.description:
Cast Daydream by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Skullwinder and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Skullwinder trigger.
Resolve the Skullwinder trigger, returning Daydream from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Daydream.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Skullwinder and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

140-3245-6734.description:
Activate Shadowcloak Vampire by paying life.
Repeat step 1 as desired.
Activate Rowan by tapping it, reducing the cost of all black and/or red spells you cast this turn.
Cast Exsanguinate, choosing for X to equal the amount of life you've lost this turn, but paying a total of {B}{B} due to Rowan.
Resolve Exsanguinate, causing each opponent to lose X life, and you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.

uses.n: Grub, Storied Matriarch // Grub, Notorious Auntie

2105-4068-7196.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
2105-4068-7196.description:
Declare Grub and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks. Grub and Combat Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Grub trigger, putting a -1/-1 counter on Combat Celebrant and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of it.
Combat Celebrant dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Resolve the Combat Celebrant trigger, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase, using the Combat Celebrant token instead.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2438-6972-7338.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Putrid Pals.
When Putrid Pals dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

1417-4050-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
1417-4050-7084.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Bridge from Below and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bridge from Below trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with three charge counters on it

1978-2593-7280.description:
Animate Astral Cornucopia using Donatello.
Activate Astral Cornucopia by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Astral Cornucopia.
Repeat from step 2.

1651-2097-3340-6871.description:
Activate Bootleggers' Stash by tapping it, as it's a land due to Toph, creating two Treasure tokens due to Jolene.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Treasures, untapping Bootleggers' Stash.
Repeat.

3698-6871-6879-6880.description:
Cast Stonework Puma by paying {3}.
When Stonework Puma enters, Grinding Station and Haru trigger.
Resolve the Haru trigger, targeting Stonework Puma as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Stonework Puma.
When Stonework Puma dies, Haru triggers, returning Stonework Puma from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Stonework Puma enters, Grinding Station and Haru trigger.
Resolve the Haru trigger, targeting Stonework Puma as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 5.
Repeat from step 5.

1874-5641-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1874-5641-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Ajani's Welcome triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1020-1117-1796-6518.description:
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {0}.
When Myr Retriever enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Myr Retriever and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Junk Diver from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Junk Diver by paying {0}.
When Junk Diver enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Junk Diver and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Junk Diver dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1690-2538-3836-5034.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact card in hand that can be cast for {0} due to Urza.
1690-2538-3836-5034.description:
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast an artifact by paying {0}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning Sol Ring to your hand.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast Sol Ring by paying {0}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning the artifact cast in step 3 to your hand.
Repeat.
1690-2538-3836-5034.notes: You can use an artifact creature to get infinite ETB and LTB triggers. If you do not use a creature, this combo will not produce those results.

4377-4823-5626.manaNeeded: {4}{U}{U} the first turn, with {6}{U}{U}{B}{B} each extra turn
4377-4823-5626.notablePrerequisites:
You control a nontoken creature with mana value 2 or less.
You have at least {E}.
4377-4823-5626.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}{E}, sacrificing a creature with mana value 2 or less, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Timeless Witness from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Timeless Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying at most {E}{E}, sacrificing Timeless Witness, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning a creature with mana value 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Staff of Domination

661-1651-2364-2645.description:
Activate Mana Vault by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Sculpting Steel and Staff of Domination, untapping Mana Vault.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Activate Sculpting Steel's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Staff of Domination's other abilities.

628-2511-5405.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Soulstinger.
When Soulstinger dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Soulstinger enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability
Repeat.

692-2762-4050-4613.notablePrerequisites: Wildwood Mentor has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
692-2762-4050-4613.description:
Activate Wildwood Mentor using Thopter Squadron's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
When the Thopter enters the battlefield, Wildwood Mentor's first ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Thopter, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1912-2113-4687.notablePrerequisites:
Karametra's Favor attached to Gilder Bairn.
Gilder Bairn does not have summoning sickness.
1912-2113-4687.description:
Activate Gilder Bairn by tapping it, adding {G/U}.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on target permanent.
Repeat.

413-678-1778.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Memnite.
When Memnite dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Memnite to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
When Memnite enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

3784-4055-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Vhal.
Vhal does not have summoning sickness.
3784-4055-4222.description:
Activate Vhal by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C} that cannot be spent to cast spells from your hand.
Activate Energy Refractor by paying {2}, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Vhal.
Repeat.

1284-2375-4136-4831-5077.notablePrerequisites:
Viridian Longbow attached to Scaretiller.
Scaretiller does not have summoning sickness.
1284-2375-4136-4831-5077.description:
Activate Scaretiller by tapping it, targeting Cacophodon.
Scaretiller triggers, returning Riveteers Overlook from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Riveteers Overlook enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Roaring Earth.
Resolve the Roaring Earth trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Cacophodon.
Resolve the Riveteers Overlook trigger, causing you to sacrifice it and search your library for a basic Mountain, Swamp or Forest and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
If you put a land onto the battlefield this way, Roaring Earth triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the Scaretiller ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to Cacophodon.
Cacophodon triggers, untapping Scaretiller.
Repeat.

3172-5128-5256.notablePrerequisites:
Patron of the Orochi in graveyard with a sticker on it.
You control Forests that tap for at least {4}{B}.
3172-5128-5256.description:
Activate Scampire by paying {3}{B}, returning Patron of the Orochi from your graveyard to the battlefield and giving it haste.
Activate Patron of the Orochi by tapping it, untapping all Forests and green creatures.
Tap those permanents to add at least {4}{B}.
Sacrifice Patron of the Orochi to Altar of Dementia, milling target player seven cards.
Repeat.

132-198-2645.description:
Activate Myr Welder using Empowered Autogenerator's ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding one mana of any color for each charge counter on it.
If Staff of Domination is exiled, activate Myr Welder using Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Otherwise, activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Myr Welder. Then, activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
132-198-2645.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can use Staff of Domination's other abilities. The starting mana requirement assumes that Staff of Domination is on the battlefield and that Myr Welder has no charge counters on it. If Staff of Domination is exiled, the starting cost is {0}.

2499-3634-3821.easyPrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can collectively tap to produce at least {3}{U}{U}.
2499-3634-3821.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{U}.
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying {4}{U}.
When Peregrine Drake enters, it triggers twice. Resolve the first trigger, untapping five lands.
Holding priority, activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{U}.
Resolve the second Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping five lands.
Cast Venser by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Venser enters, it triggers twice, returning it and Peregrine Drake from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

679-2428.description:
Draw a card, either with your draw step or by casting a card draw spell, which triggers Horizon Chimeria and gains you a life.
Gaining a life triggers Lich's Mastery, drawing a card.
Repeat to draw your library.
You do not lose the game after drawing your last card because Lich's Mastery is on the battlefield.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization
